evidence: Single package (deletetweets) indicates tight coupling and single deployment unit
Clear module separation with deletetweets.py (core logic), __main__.py (CLI entry point), and tests/test_deletetweets.py (isolated test module)
Use of classes (TweetReader, TweetDestroyer) with testable abstractions (FakeTwitterApi, FakeReader) suggests separation of concerns within one module
Minimal directory depth (2) and flat structure consistent with small-scale modular monoliths
Presence of setup.py and __init__.py indicates proper Python package structure for a single, cohesive application
risks: As project grows, risk of growing coupling if modular boundaries are not enforced
Single package may become monolithic over time without deliberate modularity maintenance
